Faq.title: PictoPy FAQs
Faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about PictoPy's smart photo organization and AI-powered tagging features.

q1.question: What is PictoPy?
q1.answer: PictoPy is an intelligent photo management application that uses advanced AI to automatically tag and organize your photos based on detected objects, faces, and scenes. It's designed to make your photo collection searchable and easily accessible while maintaining your privacy.

q2.question: How does the smart tagging feature work?
q2.answer: PictoPy runs state-of-the-art computer-vision models directly on your machine. Object detection recognizes what is in each picture, while face recognition and clustering group photos of the same person together, so you can find any photo with a simple search.

q3.question: Is my privacy protected when using PictoPy?
q3.answer: Yes. PictoPy is fully offline by design. Every photo is analyzed locally on your device, and nothing is ever uploaded, tracked, or shared with a server. Your library never leaves your machine.

q4.question: What platforms does PictoPy support?
q4.answer: PictoPy ships as a native desktop application for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It's built with Tauri, combining a React frontend with a Rust core and a Python backend for AI processing.

q5.question: How can I contribute to PictoPy?
q5.answer: PictoPy is open source and maintained by the AOSSIE community. Head over to the GitHub repository to pick an issue, improve the docs, or join the Discord to discuss ideas. Contributions of every size are welcome.
